svg.aria-label: What's in the box. In the box, in orchestration, the harness kit and workforce: one coding flow, the harness kit's coder, which Shift Manager runs on; a typed task input that filing and claim check, with harness, model and plan as its run settings, server-owned fields the flow's filler writes, never the filer; one order, task then worker then kit default, run at the first claim and frozen on the run record, which work, steer, message, door and resume alike read, with a worker able to lock its harness, a refused harness failing the task and a refused model falling to the harness default by name; a model feed into every harness; Code with as a turn-written session field, codeWith, which the harness kit's filler writes into the task at filing. A fence under it: what ran is read from the run, never from the pick. Composed in by the app: its default coder in one place, and its picker. Replaced in one line: Teammates' Coding harness text line (the lab's Coder: line goes with its workers, in FIX-2598), Lead's fallback and the client constant, the unread agent-flow harness setting, Shift Manager's second harness list. Not built here: harness sessions' own model pick, the lab's model picker (FIX-2598), run settings beyond harness, model and plan, and PR policy as coder-flow options (FIX-2583).
